_doc: Curated list of films, key One Piece events, and milestones for the Chapter Release Map. Films are sourced from Wikipedia 'List of One Piece films'. Events are project-curated based on widely-documented dates. Each entry has: kind, name, date (YYYY-MM-DD), optional chapter, optional summary.

events.name: Manga begins (WSJ Issue #34)
events.summary: Romance Dawn — One Piece launches in Weekly Shonen Jump.

events.name: Film 3: Chopper's Kingdom on the Island of Strange Animals
Film 6: Baron Omatsuri and the Secret Island
Film 7: Giant Mecha Soldier of Karakuri Castle
Film 10: Strong World
events.summary: Chapter 0 of the Strong World special — Roger-era backstory.

events.name: Marineford concludes · Ace dies
events.summary: The most quoted death in modern shonen.

events.name: Two-year timeskip
events.summary: 3D2Y — the crew separates and trains for two years.

events.name: Final Saga begins
events.summary: Egghead arc begins; the final stretch.

events.name: Oda eye surgery break (manga)
events.summary: 1-month break announced for Oda's astigmatism surgery.

events.name: Anime hiatus begins
events.summary: Anime pauses after Episode 1088 for production reset and remake.

events.name: Anime resumes — Egghead arc
events.summary: Episode 1089 airs after the production break (rough estimate).

events.name: Elbaph arc begins
events.summary: The Final Saga moves to the Land of Giants.
